_meta.how: Each fact a Daily Huddle question uses, checked live on 2026-10-18 against the company's own pages, SEC filings or acquisition news; "Ok" means the source agrees with src/assets/data/vendors.json, and the value beside it is what the source says.
_meta.corrected: 2026-10-18: the directory took the checked value for the facts marked Ok in that pass (see each note)

aarc-american-assn-for-respiratory-care.note: HQ is 16479 Dallas Parkway, Suite 420, Addison, TX, not Irving; AARC timeline says the Inhalation Therapy Association formed July 13, 1946 and was chartered as a not-for-profit in Illinois April 15, 1947. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

abbott.note: Abbott completed its purchase of Exact Sciences on March 23, 2026, so it now also runs Exact's testing labs.

abridge.hqSrc: Pittsburgh Startup News, citing the Pittsburgh and San Francisco Business Times
abridge.note: Arguable: in March 2025 Abridge's COO called San Francisco the primary headquarters while a spokesperson said Pittsburgh remains corporate HQ, and its 2026 releases are datelined San Francisco.

acc-american-college-of-cardiology.src: American College of Cardiology, About page

aha-american-hospital-association.hqSrc: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, IRS Form 990 filing FY2024
aha-american-hospital-association.note: AHA's own pages list a Chicago office and a Washington, DC office without naming either the headquarters; its IRS filing gives Chicago, IL.

aidoc.hqSrc: Goldman Sachs Asset Management press release (Aidoc Series E)
aidoc.note: Aidoc's own pages name no headquarters; its April 2026 Series E release is datelined New York and Pulse2 calls it New York-based, while an Aidoc job posting (Sept 2026) puts its offices at 34 HaMasger Street, Tel Aviv; HQ is arguable between New York and Tel Aviv.

altera-digital-health.note: Altera names no headquarters. Its contact page lists Chicago as one of eight offices, while its 2025 and 2026 releases are datelined Niagara Falls, N.Y. Sells Sunrise, Paragon and TouchWorks EHRs plus CareInMotion interoperability and Ventus revenue tools.

amazon-web-services-aws.note: HealthScribe drafts clinical notes from conversations (aws.amazon.com/healthscribe); HealthImaging stores medical images in the cloud.

amn-healthcare.note: History page dates the company to American Mobile Nurses, founded March 1985; the AMN Healthcare name came in 1998.

arcadia.note: Corporate HQ Boston; mail goes to Burlington, MA. About page notes a 2025 partnership with Nordic Capital (ownership not checked).

artera.note: Santa Barbara comes from press release datelines; the site names no HQ or address.

athenahealth.note: Careers site refers to our Boston headquarters and job listings give 80 Guest St, Boston, MA, and describe its EHR, practice management and athenaCollector revenue cycle products. Founded not found: athenahealth.com blocks fetches and no acceptable source stated the year (Wikipedia says 1997).

aya-healthcare.note: Founding year not found on any Aya page or press release checked.

bayesian-health-sepsis-ai.note: The platform is no longer sepsis only: it also targets deterioration, readmissions, heart failure, pressure injury and malnutrition.

biointellisense.note: Company page says since its founding in 2019 (directory says 2018); also names a Redwood City, CA presence beside the Golden HQ. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

brightside-health.note: Rechecked 2026-10-18: brightside.com refuses fetches, so hq and city rest on its Terms of Use (primary mailing address 2261 Market Street, San Francisco) and the kind on its October 2025 release (virtual therapy, psychiatry, intensive outpatient), read from search results on its own domain; founded 2017 not found on an acceptable source.

cencora.note: Cencora distributes pharmaceuticals (wholesale and specialty) rather than med-surg supplies; it also markets drug development support and World Courier logistics.

centene.note: Centene fact sheet (2024 Q3) lists Behavioral Health Services among its businesses: https://centene.com/content/dam/centenedotcom/investor_docs/CNC-FactSheet-2024-Q3.pdf

chg-healthcare.note: The headquarters building is in Midvale and 2026 releases are datelined Midvale, Utah, but CHG's 2026 boilerplate says Headquartered in Salt Lake City (the metro), so Midvale could be argued.

chime.note: chimecentral.org would not fetch (403); address and founding year taken from chimecentral.org search results.

cleerly.src: FDA 510(k) database, K261210 (Cleerly, Inc., 1099 18th St., Denver)
cleerly.note: Founded not found on an acceptable source; only Cleerly's recruiting boilerplate on job boards says 2017. Its own site names no HQ (remote-first, hubs in Denver, NYC and Lisbon); press releases are datelined Denver, and the 2020 510(k) gave a New York address.

clinical-pathology-laboratories.ownerSrc: Sonic Healthcare USA, Who We Are page
clinical-pathology-laboratories.note: Both pages blocked fetching (HTTP 403); facts taken from search results on those same domains: HQ 9200 Wall Street, Austin; Sonic entered the US in 2005 by buying CPL.

cohere-health.note: Release says headquartered in Boston; work is prior authorization and, since the 2025 ZignaAI deal, payment integrity for health plans, so rcm fits through prior auth and claims accuracy rather than provider billing.

costco-health.note: 10-K lists pharmacy, optical and hearing aids; the $29 virtual primary care visits for members are run by Sesame (sesamecare.com/costco), not Costco itself.

covermymeds.note: Closed April 3, 2017. The HQ line is from that 2017 filing; CoverMyMeds' own site refused fetches (HTTP 429), so Columbus was not re-confirmed on a current company page.

cross-country-healthcare.note: Founding year not found; the 10-K says nearly 40 years of expertise, which fits 1986 but states no year. Aya ended its merger agreement effective December 4, 2025, then Knox Lane acquired Cross Country on July 21, 2026 ($13.25 a share) and it was delisted, so the directory's NASDAQ: CCRN and independent status are stale.

current-health.foundedSrc: UK Companies House, Current Health Limited (formerly SNAP40 Limited)
current-health.note: HQ arguable: HHCN 2025 calls it Boston-based, but the legal entity Current Health Limited is registered in Edinburgh, Scotland (privacy policy, Companies House) and 2021 reports called it Edinburgh-headquartered. Incorporated 7 July 2014 as SNAP40 Limited; UKTech News 2021 says founded in 2015. The directory description still says owned by Best Buy Health; Best Buy sold it back to its co-founder in June 2025. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

cynerio.note: Axonius acquired Cynerio (completed, July 29, 2025, over $100 million) and cynerio.com now redirects to Axonius for Healthcare, so the directory owner Cynerio (private) is out of date; HQ recorded is Axonius U.S. headquarters, New York. Founded: not found. Not asked as a company that sells today: Axonius bought it in July 2025 and cynerio.com redirects (2026-10-18). Owner checked live 2026-10-18 and corrected in the directory.

deepscribe.note: HQ read from the San Francisco dateline on its 2026 releases; the boilerplate names no city. DeepScribe now markets itself mainly to oncology.

doximity.note: Incorporated April 2010 as 3MD Communications. Its telehealth is a free voice and video calling tool clinicians use for virtual visits (Dialer), not a care service of its own.

eclinicalworks.note: Contact page headquarters: 2 Technology Dr, Westborough, MA; About page lists RCM, patient engagement (healow), healow TeleVisits, population health and eClinicalWorks Scribe.

edwards-lifesciences.note: Edwards says its roots date to 1958, when Lowell Edwards set out to build an artificial heart; that counts from a predecessor, so the year is arguable.

eko-health.note: Founded year not found in company sources (a June 2023 release cites over 10 years of work); a May 2023 release said Oakland, current releases say Emeryville.

epic-deterioration-index.note: STAT calls the Deterioration Index an AI system created by Epic; Epic's current AI page (epic.com/software/ai) names Art, AI Charting, Emmie and Penny but not the Deterioration Index.

epic-systems.note: Contact page gives 1979 Milky Way, Verona, Wisconsin; Epic released its native AI Charting ambient documentation in February 2026, so scribing fits.

exact-sciences.note: Abbott completed its purchase on March 23, 2026 and Exact is now a wholly owned Abbott subsidiary, so the directory owner text (public) is out of date. Owner checked live 2026-10-18 and corrected in the directory.

findhelp.note: Analytics is one of four core solutions beside closed-loop referrals; TPG's Rise Funds invested about $250 million in March 2026 (stake not disclosed).

finthrive.note: Boilerplate names no headquarters; the release is datelined Plano, TX and the contact page lists 7950 Legacy Drive, Plano.

fortified-health-security.note: About page lists 120 Brentwood Commons Way, Brentwood, TN, and its 2025 releases are datelined Brentwood; Franklin is out of date. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

freed-ai.note: Footer gives a San Francisco mailing address (548 Market St, a PMB); staff work from NYC or SF offices and no HQ is named.

ge-healthcare.note: 10-K principal executive offices 500 W. Monroe Street, Chicago, IL; segments include imaging with AI-enabled software, ultrasound, patient monitoring and diagnostic cardiology.

ghx-global-healthcare-exchange.note: Every GHX page and its privacy notice (updated May 2026) give 3615 Delgany Street, Denver, CO as the company address; a 2025 release was datelined Louisville, CO; no page uses the word headquarters. GHX is a cloud supply chain network and software company; it neither distributes supplies nor runs a GPO. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

goodrx.note: 10-K principal executive offices 2701 Olympic Boulevard, Santa Monica, CA; it still offers cash-pay telehealth visits and the Gold subscription.

google-health.note: The MASAI trial the directory credits used Transpara by ScreenPoint, not Google (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT04838756).

google-health-ai-mammography.note: Google calls it a research model tested with partners (Northwestern, Imperial College and three NHS trusts); the MASAI trial the directory credits used Transpara by ScreenPoint, not Google (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT04838756).

guardant-health.note: S-1 says incorporated in Delaware in 2011 as Guardant Health, Inc.; no company source found stating 2012. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

headspace.note: Terms say Headspace is located at 595 Market Street, San Francisco, and its 2026 releases are datelined San Francisco, not Santa Monica. Its press page lists a 2026-09-16 release, Sword to acquire Headspace; close not confirmed. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

health-catalyst.note: 10-K says founded in 2008 and launched operations in 2008; the current legal entity was incorporated in Delaware in September 2011 as HQC Holdings. alsoFits from its Upfront and Twistle patient engagement lines and Vitalware mid revenue cycle.

health-gorilla.note: Site names no headquarters; its January 2026 release is datelined Coral Gables, Fla. and an August 2026 one Coral Springs, Fla.; it was founded in Silicon Valley but Sunnyvale was not found. Epic sued it in January 2026.

heartflow.note: Principal executive offices moved in 2026 from Mountain View to 135 Main Street, San Francisco (Q1 2026 release cites the headquarters relocation). The About page timeline says founded 2010, but the 10-K says the company was incorporated in July 2007 as Cardiovascular Simulation, Inc. (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1464521/000146452126000042/R26.htm). Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

himss.note: HIMSS names two headquarters: a Global Headquarters in Rotterdam, Netherlands (announced at HIMSS23 Europe) and an Americas Headquarters in Chicago, IL (550 W. Van Buren); page would not fetch (403), facts from himss.org search results; the annual conference is now produced by Informa Connect.

hippocratic-ai.note: No HQ named; its April 2026 release is datelined Palo Alto and its August 2026 release Menlo Park. Its voice agents do outreach, follow-up and scheduling, and the company says they do not diagnose or prescribe, so bedside decision support is a stretch.

humana.note: Humana offers members behavioral health care, including by telehealth (provider.humana.com behavioral health pages; CenterWell care teams include behavioral health specialists).

imprivata.note: S-1 says incorporated in Delaware on May 7, 2001; the company history page starts at 2002 (funding secured), so 2002 is arguable.

included-health.note: Founded not found: company pages and press boilerplate give no year; it formed from the 2021 combination of Grand Rounds and Doctor On Demand. It closed on Firefly Health and launched Included Health Plans in October 2026.

innovaccer.note: Founded not found: About, Careers and press boilerplate give no year.

intelerad.note: No headquarters named: Raleigh is the first of five offices listed and its 2025 dateline, it began in Montreal, and GE HealthCare completed its purchase on March 18, 2026 (GE HealthCare press release), so the directory owner Hg Capital is out of date. Owner checked live 2026-10-18 and corrected in the directory.

intersystems.note: Global headquarters is now One Congress Street, Boston; a 2023 release still said Cambridge. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

iqvia.note: Cover page gives 2400 Ellis Rd., Durham, NC; Item 2 calls the same executive headquarters Research Triangle Park, North Carolina.

irhythm-technologies.note: iRhythm Technologies was incorporated in Delaware in September 2006; the listed company is now iRhythm Holdings, a successor registrant incorporated in December 2025.

kenvue.note: Kimberly-Clark deal still pending as of October 2026 (note exchange offers under way per an October 13, 2026 Form 8-K).

komodo-health.note: Releases are datelined New York & San Francisco and no office is labeled headquarters (contact page lists NYC first, then San Francisco, Los Altos, Chicago, Chennai), so New York alone is arguable.

labcorp.note: Labcorp counts from Biomedical Laboratories (1969, 50th anniversary marked in 2019) and formed as Laboratory Corporation of America in 1995; 1978 not found.

luma-health.note: The About page's only address is 3 East 3rd Ave, San Mateo, CA, not San Francisco. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

lyra-health.note: Contact page labels 700 Gateway Boulevard, South San Francisco, CA as headquarters, not Burlingame. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

masimo.kindSrc: Masimo, SafetyNet home and hospital remote monitoring page
masimo.note: Not checked but stale: Danaher completed its purchase of Masimo on 2026-06-10, Masimo stopped trading on Nasdaq and is a Danaher subsidiary (https://www.masimo.com/media/danaher-completes-acquisition-of-masimo-corporation), so the directory's public ownership is out of date. Owner checked live 2026-10-18 and corrected in the directory.

mckesson.note: About page says it distributes pharmaceuticals and medical supplies (Medical-Surgical Solutions segment) and names CoverMyMeds, Ontada and Sarah Cannon Research Institute trials.

meditech.hqSrc: MEDITECH press release via Business Wire (HIMSS26)
meditech.note: Every 2026 MEDITECH release is datelined Canton, Mass. (7 Blue Hill River Road), older ones Westwood; MEDITECH's locations page lists both campuses and names no headquarters, so Westwood is arguable; founded August 4, 1969.

medline-industries.note: Medline went public: IPO completed December 18, 2025 (Nasdaq: MDLN), with the sponsors and the Mills family still large holders. The directory's owner text (PE consortium, ownership pe) is stale.

medtronic.hqSrc: Medtronic plc, SEC EDGAR company record
medtronic.note: Medtronic plc says it is headquartered in Galway, Ireland (SEC address Parkmore Business Park West, Galway); its operational headquarters is 710 Medtronic Parkway, Minneapolis, MN, so the HQ is arguable. Also: the MiniMed diabetes business separated on October 15, 2026, so the directory's diabetes line is out of date.

modmed-modernizing-medicine.note: About page: founded in 2010 by Dan Cane and Dr. Michael Sherling, headquartered in Boca Raton, FL; markets RCM, patient engagement and an ambient listening tool.

nabla.note: Nabla names no headquarters: it says it runs two hubs, Paris and New York (US office in Brooklyn), and its 2025 and 2026 releases are datelined New York.

natera.note: S-1 says formed in California as Gene Security Network, LLC in November 2003, incorporated in Delaware in 2007, renamed Natera in 2012. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

nextgen-connect-mirth.note: Now sold as Mirth Connect by NextGen Healthcare under a flat-fee commercial license; the page does not offer it as open source or use the name NextGen Connect.

nextgen-healthcare.note: NextGen names no headquarters on its site; its 2026 releases are datelined New York, NY and the 2023 Thoma Bravo release called it a remote-first company, so Atlanta is not supported. Founded 1974 as Quality Systems, Inc., the same company renamed. Also: Thoma Bravo's release dates the completed $1.8B buyout November 10, 2023, not 2024 as the directory says.

notable.note: Founded not found: no founding year on the company's pages.

nuance-dax-copilot.note: Deal announced April 2021, closed March 4, 2022. DAX Copilot now ships inside Microsoft Dragon Copilot (launched March 2025), which also has a radiology workflow with PowerScribe One. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

nvidia.kindSrc: NVIDIA, healthcare platform page (MONAI, BioNeMo, Parabricks)

omnicell.note: About page says Headquarters, Fort Worth, Texas; SEC business address is 4220 North Freeway, Fort Worth, TX.

openevidence.note: No HQ named; the July 2025 release is datelined Cambridge, Mass., but its 2026 releases (March, July, October) are datelined Miami. Launched Coding Intelligence for billing in March 2026.

oscar-health.note: Oscar Medical Group has virtual behavioral health clinicians who give therapy to members of some plans (hioscar.com/resources-for-mental-health).

owens-minor.note: Contact page lists O&M Global Headquarters at 10900 Nuckols Road, Glen Allen, VA (its map link still points to Mechanicsville); the FAQ says headquartered in Richmond. Since December 31, 2025 the Owens & Minor name belongs to the distribution and products business owned by Platinum Equity; the former public parent (NYSE: OMI) renamed itself Accendra Health (NYSE: ACH), Glen Allen, VA. Directory owner text is stale.

palantir.note: Principal executive offices moved from Denver to 19505 Biscayne Blvd., Aventura, FL (Miami area) in February 2026; Palantir is a data and AI software platform company, big tech by size rather than a cloud provider. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

philips.src: Koninklijke Philips N.V., SEC EDGAR company record (20-F filed 2026-02-19)
philips.note: SEC business address Prinses Irenestraat 59, Amsterdam; Philips still sells consumer personal health products (a Lumea launch in September 2026).

phreesia.note: Phreesia is fully remote and says it no longer maintains a principal executive office; the 10-K cover lists a mailbox at 1521 Concord Pike, Wilmington, DE. No New York HQ.

pointclickcare.note: All 2026 PointClickCare releases are datelined Toronto, and the contact page lists Toronto (8 Spadina Ave) before Mississauga (5570 Explorer Dr) with neither labelled headquarters, so Mississauga is arguable. Founded not found: the site says only 20+ years and almost a quarter century. Vox Advantage ambient documentation launched August 2026.

premier-inc.note: Premier was taken private on November 25, 2025 (merger with Premium Parent, LLC; SEC Form 8-K, then delisted); the directory's NASDAQ: PINC is stale. About page lists its GPO plus analytics, clinical decision support and real-world evidence.

procter-gamble-health.note: Health Care segment is 14% of net sales: Crest, Oral-B, Metamucil, Pepto-Bismol, Vicks.

qgenda.note: Deal announced Aug 12, 2024; Hearst's 2024 letter says Hearst Health bought QGenda in 2024, exact close date not found (hearst.com blocked fetching, read from its search results). QGenda is workforce management software, not a staffing agency.

quest-diagnostics.note: 10-K says Quest was incorporated in Delaware in 1990 and its predecessor companies date back to 1967, so 1967 counts from a predecessor.

r1-rcm.note: r1rcm.com refused the fetch; the Murray, Utah dateline comes from search results on r1rcm.com and globenewswire.com, and SEC filings for R1 RCM Inc. list 434 W. Ascension Way, Murray, UT. engage from its patient access and patient experience lines.

rad-ai-impressions.note: HQ taken from the San Francisco dateline on Rad AI's own August 2026 release; no page states headquarters in words.

redox.note: Founding year from the company's own site (messages processed since 2014; a Redox blog post says founded in early 2014); its About page gives no year.

rhapsody-lyniate.note: Company counts from 2018, when Hg bought the Rhapsody business from Orion Health (the engine itself shipped in 2000); it now trades as Rhapsody and says it is not Lyniate.

science-37.note: HQ moved to Morrisville, N.C. (Research Triangle Park) per an August 2024 release; 10-Ks from 2022 already gave Research Triangle Park, Culver City is an old address. Merger closed March 12, 2024. Today's site does not mention eMed. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

siemens-healthineers.src: Siemens Healthineers press release, new corporate headquarters in Erlangen
siemens-healthineers.kindSrc: Siemens Healthineers, Q3 FY2026 press release
siemens-healthineers.note: Corporate headquarters is in Erlangen; the corporate info page gives the registered office as Munich and a Forchheim address, all in Germany.

solventum.src: Solventum, Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (SEC)
solventum.note: Principal executive offices are now 1750 Yankee Doodle Road, Eagan, MN (2026 10-Q, 8-Ks, IR page, releases datelined Eagan); the FY2025 10-K still listed the 3M Center in Maplewood, St. Paul mailing address. Aug 2026 Solventum announced it intends to separate its Health Information Systems segment (coding, revenue cycle); not done yet. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

spring-health.note: No headquarters address published; HQ taken from the New York, NY dateline on its releases.

suki-ai.note: HQ read from the Redwood City dateline; the current boilerplate names no city (Suki's 2018 launch release said headquartered in Redwood City).

surescripts.note: HQ from the Arlington, Va. dateline on 2026 releases and the contact page listing Arlington first; a Minneapolis, MN office is also listed and no page says headquarters in words.

symplr.note: Founding year not found; the About page only says 30 years of healthcare experience. symplr sells workforce management, scheduling and credentialing software, not staffing.

talkiatry.note: The company dates itself from its launch in 2020; no company source gives 2019. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

teladoc-health.note: Headquarters is now 155 East 44th Street, New York City (About page and SEC company record), not Purchase, NY. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

the-joint-commission.src: The Joint Commission, Contact Us page
the-joint-commission.note: jointcommission.org would not fetch (403); central office One Renaissance Blvd, Oakbrook Terrace and the 1951 founding taken from jointcommission.org search results.

trubridge-cpsi-evident.note: Founded 1979 as CPSI, the same company renamed TruBridge in 2024. Owner changed: the 8-K says the merger closed July 9, 2026 and TruBridge is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Inventurus Knowledge Solutions (IKS Health); it deregistered (Form 15, July 24, 2026), so the directory's public, TruBridge Inc. owner text is out of date. Owner checked live 2026-10-18 and corrected in the directory.

unite-us.hqSrc: Unite Us press release, headquarters move to 217 Broadway
unite-us.kindSrc: Unite Us, home page (Insights: Predictive Analytics)
unite-us.note: A 2019 Unite Us release also called its Culver City, CA office a West Coast headquarters; current pages do not repeat that, and 2025 releases are datelined New York.

unitedhealth-group.note: 10-Q cover lists two principal executive offices, 1 Health Drive, Eden Prairie, MN and 655 New York Avenue NW, Washington, DC; Minnetonka is the former address. Directory corrected to the checked value on 2026-10-18.

veeva-systems.note: analytics from its Compass and OpenData data products sold to life sciences.

veradigm-allscripts.note: About page says headquartered in Chicago, IL and providing healthcare solutions since 1986 (the Allscripts lineage), not literally founded; the September 2026 investor deck says shares are off a national exchange until filings are current.

visage-imaging.note: Visage names two headquarters, San Diego, California and Berlin, Germany. Wholly owned subsidiary of Pro Medicus; Visage 7 is marketed for PACS replacement.

vivian-health.note: Vivian's own pages list one address, 100 Pine St. (a PMB mailbox), San Francisco, CA, with remote teams in 31 states; no New York address found (its parent People Inc., formerly IAC, is in New York). FAQ says it is a job marketplace, not a staffing agency.

waystar.hqSrc: Waystar Holding Corp., SEC EDGAR company record (10-K filed 2026-02-17)
waystar.note: Waystar's About page says it is headquartered in Lehi, Utah, and Louisville, Kentucky, and its contact page lists four headquarters with Louisville first; the SEC principal executive office is 1550 Digital Drive, Lehi, UT, so a trivia answer of Lehi alone is arguable.

withings-health-solutions.src: French government company registry, Withings SIREN 504787565
withings-health-solutions.kindSrc: Withings, developer and partner hub (Withings RPM, Cellular Solution)
withings-health-solutions.note: withings.com blocked fetches; HQ and founding come from the official French registry (head office 2 rue Maurice Hartmann, Issy-les-Moulineaux; created 2008-06-01).
